latest_messages.headline: Midday: steady, no changes — sitting tight the day before the Fed's big decision.
latest_messages.body: Checked all three holdings and both safety nets — all healthy, nothing to trade. The ~$9k freed by this morning's ATI auto-sale stays as cash one more day, through Tuesday's Fed rate decision (don't put fresh money to work right before a big unpredictable event). Equity $98,030, down ~0.55% today (mostly the ATI sale). JPM +7.1%, CFR +0.6%, both stops resting comfortably.

latest_messages.headline: Open: safety net auto-sold ATI this morning — the risk I flagged pre-bell. No panic, no other trades.
latest_messages.body: ATI gapped below its stop on a risk-off FOMC-eve and auto-sold 47 sh @ ~$190.37 — a macro/sector shake-out, NOT a company problem (earnings/backlog intact). Gap-down made the loss ~-9% vs the -7% target. Realized -$907. Holding the freed ~$9k as cash through Tuesday's Fed decision, not chasing it back in. Now 2 stocks (JPM/CFR) + SPY cushion; 3 slots open.

latest_messages.headline: Pre-market plan: risk-off morning ahead of Tuesday's Fed decision — holding steady, no trades
latest_messages.body: Cautious tape (oil +9% on the week revives inflation worry; live FOMC Tue 9/16 ~55-65% hike). All 3 holdings' theses intact. Watching ATI (~1% above its stop). No buys before the Fed — MDT is the top candidate to reconsider after Tuesday.
